static_traits.name: Zhou Cheng
static_traits.family_status: Lives with spouse, has one child
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues have become tense due to negative thoughts about his own performance; his family is generally fairly supportive, but he is unwilling to discuss work-related problems with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no history of treatment or counseling for psychological problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to notice and describe emotions and thoughts, relatively cooperative; speech rate not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Because I did not receive a raise, I feel like a terrible employee at work.
basic_info.core_demands: Not receiving a raise and feelings of inadequacy have affected my self-esteem and overall well-being, which prompted me to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: About six months ago, Zhou Cheng realized that he had not received a raise while his colleagues had, which made him begin to feel persistently incompetent and doubt his work performance; the problem persisted and affected his self-esteem and work motivation. He tried seeking feedback from his supervisor and working harder, but saw no improvement; whenever he sees colleagues receiving recognition or rewards, this sense of inadequacy is reactivated.

During a singer audition, excessive stress caused his voice to crack and him to forget the lyrics; after failing on the spot, he repeatedly recalled the embarrassing scene and developed the thought 'I cannot sing well', began to avoid singing and even practicing, believed that trying again was meaningless, which led to a decline in interest and confidence in an activity he originally loved.

special_situations.event: Sees colleagues receiving commendation or rewards/raises
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not receive the same raise or recognition as my colleagues, it means I am incompetent and an unqualified employee
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works harder and proactively seeks feedback from his supervisor to prove himself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; I must be a terrible employee.

special_situations.event: Discovered that he had not received a raise while colleagues had (about six months ago)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the company does not give me a raise, the reason must lie with me, which shows I performed poorly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-reflects and doubles his efforts, trying to exchange improved performance for recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Not getting a raise means I am no good.

special_situations.event: After seeking feedback from his supervisor and working harder, still no obvious improvement
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I still see no change after trying hard, it proves I will never get better
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids seeking help from family, chooses to bear stress alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may never receive recognition / will never get a raise.

special_situations.event: Failed singer audition (voice cracking, forgetting lyrics)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail in public, it means I am completely no good in this area
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids singing and practicing to avoid failing and being embarrassed again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never sing well again; trying again is meaningless.

core_conflict.wish: Longing for recognition and affirmation (from supervisors, colleagues or audience)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated and humiliated, worrying about appearing inferior in comparisons
defense_goal: Controlling failure risk and earning recognition through self-criticism and redoubled effort
Avoiding high-pressure or evaluative situations to reduce shame and anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: An incompetent person who might embarrass oneself at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When topics of work performance, raises, or being compared / judged are discussed in counseling
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiences the counselor or others as possible judges, worrying about being negated or looked down on
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Restrained and brief tone, downplays emotions, brushes over with 'it is nothing' and 'not important', or turns to objective details, avoiding going deeply into feelings.

manifestations: Although having a supportive family, unwilling to discuss work-related troubles with family
After a failed audition, chooses to bear shame and fear alone, rarely seeking emotional support from others
outcomes: Diminished enthusiasm for singing and avoiding trying

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When negative thoughts appear, avoiding them by distracting attention
When facing singing-related topics, chooses not to practice, to dodge the anxiety of being evaluated

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection abilities, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently engaging in self-criticism (such as 'I am no good' 'I should overcome it')
Caring intensely about others' evaluations; restricting action out of fear of failure

positive_force: The family overall is fairly supportive (there are family members to confide in)
Willing to proactively seek supervisor feedback and work harder
Before the audition, once enjoyed performing and had confidence in singing, possessing a foundation of engagement and enthusiasm
Having awareness of seeking help and proactively seeking psychological counseling
negative_force: Attributes not receiving a raise mainly to own inadequacy, prone to personalization, catastrophizing, and self-labeling
Over-relying on external recognition (raises, commendations) to assess self-worth
In evaluated or high-pressure situations, reduces anxiety through avoidance (such as not practicing, no longer singing)
Unwilling to discuss work troubles with family, making it hard for support to translate into actual resources
Negative automatic thoughts recur, eroding self-esteem and motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecation and catastrophizing thinking appearing in the situation of not receiving a raise while others are commended (such as 'I am a terrible employee')
antecedent: Seeing colleagues receive recognition or rewards/pay raises
Realizing I haven't gotten a raise yet
Thinking about work performance being compared and judged
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief equating raises and recognition with the quality of personal ability; tends to personalize complex outcomes as being due to one's own inadequacy
target_behavior.function: Seeks a certain explanation for 'not getting a raise' through self-blame, and attempts to drive improvement through self-pressure
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged self-esteem, decreased work motivation, strained interpersonal relationships (with colleagues)

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding singing and practice (out of fear of failing again and embarrassment)
antecedent: Recalling the situation of a failed audition
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizes a single public failure into a wholesale lack of ability, forming negative beliefs of all-or-nothing thinking and fortune telling
target_behavior.function: Escaping the shame and anxiety brought by being judged
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced interest and pleasure, stagnant skills, further worsening self-denial
